name: papyrus
description: Write LaTeX beside a live PDF preview and a paper-scoped Kiro Crew co-author chat that reads and edits LaTeX. Cmd+S (Ctrl+S on Windows/Linux) compiles with pdflatex or tectonic; clickable errors jump to their lines. Clone papers from any Git remote, then commit and push from the toolbar.
author: tricatte
highlights: Split-pane LaTeX editor with a live PDF preview beside it
Compile on save (Cmd+S, or Ctrl+S on Windows and Linux) via pdflatex or tectonic, with the bibtex cycle run for you
No TeX installed? One click installs a verified Tectonic compiler into Papyrus’s own folder
Compiler errors and warnings parsed into a clickable list that jumps to the line
AI co-author chat scoped to the paper — it reads and edits the LaTeX you are looking at
Clone a paper from any git remote, then commit, pull, and push from the toolbar
Never runs the compiler with shell escape, so a hostile .tex file cannot execute commands
useCases: Write a LaTeX paper beside its compiled PDF, jump from build errors to source, and collaborate with a paper-scoped agent.
configuration: Install managed Tectonic from the app or put tectonic or pdflatex on PATH, then create a paper or clone a repository with non-interactive Git credentials already configured.
